player_prompt.intro:
Mangisulbar ka na Sokoban puzzle. Sika'y player tan kaipapan mo itulak amin ya kahon ed targets.
        No sikay napatong ed kahon, itulak mo itan ya onpapunta ed sakey a direksyon.
        Agka makatulak ya kahon baleg ed pader, tan agka makapull ya kahon.
        Ed board, say objects so represented as: 
        - Say player (sika) so lumabas a 'P' 
        - Say pader so represented ed '#' 
        - Say kahon so marked a 'X' 
        - Say empty goals so ipapakita ed 'O'
        - Say kahon ed goals so visualized ed '√'
        Sikay met makagamit [w] para ed taas, [a] para ed kawigi, [s] para ed baba, tan [d] para ed kanan.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say naisubmit a mugimugit et sa met a salatan a porma. Gawaten [up], [down], [left], [right] o [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Say inyakar ya akasabi et aliwan valid a gawa.
invalid_move.invalid_position: Agtoon ya move - agka makalakad ed sayan posisyon.

game_message.pushed_prefix: inyan to so kahon legan ya manpapabatik.

outcome.win: Komendasyon! Asolusyonan yo so misteryo na Sokoban.
